page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr6.20xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The instance features 80 dedicated physical cores with a single thread per core configuration, resulting in 80 vCPUs. It is equipped with 768.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 9.6 GB per core.

This server type utilizes the KVM hypervisor and does not include any local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for operating system and application data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 25 Gbps. No graphics processing units are bundled with this configuration.

The high memory density of 9.6 GB per core positions this instance for memory-intensive workloads rather than compute-bound or storage-heavy tasks. The dedicated physical core allocation ensures consistent CPU performance without resource contention, though the lack of local storage introduces dependency on network-attached storage latency. This resource profile is structured for large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems, enterprise resource planning applications, and memory-heavy data processing pipelines.
